result.description:
BAM Hay Investment Trust trading as, Oracle Business Accountants are an established Gold Coast accounting practice based in Mermaid Beach seeking a qualified full-time Accountant to join our small, professional team.

Our firm works closely with business and individual clients to thoughtfully manage financial affairs, effectively manage risks, identify opportunities and support long-term growth.

This role involves responsibility for managing a diverse portfolio of clients and delivering a range of high-quality accounting, taxation and advisory services. The successful candidate will contribute to client success by ensuring accurate compliance work as well as being an asset within the firm’s collaborative environment.

Key Responsibilities

- Preparation of financial statements and income tax returns for a variety of entities including individuals, companies, trusts and partnerships
- BAS and IAS preparation, review, and lodgement
- Australian taxation compliance and tax planning support
- Ongoing client liaison and advisory support
- Use of cloud accounting software to manage, reconcile and analyse accounts
- Contribute to business advisory and structuring work where required
- Maintain internal workflows and meet key deadlines consistently

Essential Skills & Experience

- 4+ years experience in an Australian public practice accounting role
- assisting in formulating budgetary and accounting policies
- preparing financial statements for presentation to boards of directors, management, shareholders, and governing and statutory bodies
- conducting financial investigations, preparing reports, undertaking audits and advising on matters such as the purchase and sale of businesses, mergers, capital financing, suspected fraud, insolvency and taxation
- examining operating costs and organisations' income and expenditure
- providing assurance about the accuracy of information contained in financial reports and their compliance with statutory requirements
- providing financial and taxation advice on business structures, plans and operations
- preparing taxation returns for individuals and organisations
- liaising with financial institutions and brokers to establish funds management arrangements
- introducing and maintaining accounting systems, and advising on the selection and application of computer-based accounting systems
- maintaining internal control systems
- may appraise cash flow and financial risk of capital investment projects

About Us:

Structability is a dynamic and expanding force in the building insurance industry. Our head office is located in Rockdale and our operations span from all over NSW and ACT. We endeavour to understand our client’s business so that we can best support them in achieving their goals.

You will play a key role in ensuring our office runs smoothly, our engineers are well-supported, and our clients receive timely, professional service. This position suits someone ready to step beyond basic admin duties and take ownership of more complex tasks and operational responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities
Operational Administration
Manage day-to-day office operations including phones, emails, digital filing, and workflow coordination
Coordinate engineer schedules, job allocations, and client updates
Maintain accurate internal records, documentation, and reporting
Handle client communication including enquiries, follow-ups, and service updates
Support management with administrative tasks and project coordination
Assist with KPI monitoring and performance tracking
Identify workflow issues and recommend improvements
Support onboarding and training of junior staff when required
Manage more complex client enquiries with professionalism and confidence
Represent the Structability brand with a high level of professionalism

Essential
Previous experience in an administrative role (2–3 years preferred)
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail
Ability to manage competing deadlines and work independently
Confident communication skills both written and verbal
Proficiency in Microsoft Office 360
Strong problem-solving ability and initiative
Ability to work effectively within a close team environment
Current driver’s licence
Experience coordinating teams, schedules, or operational workflows
Familiarity with KPI tracking or reporting
Experience in engineering, construction, or professional services administration



Selection Criteria:
- Positive attitude with strong problem-solving skills
- Proven ability to meet tight deadlines and stay composed under pressure
- Exceptional organisational and administrative skills with keen attention to detail
- Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office 360 applications (word, excel etc.)
- Ability to write in a professional context
- Completion of Secondary Education
- Basic computer skills
- Ability to multitask
- Work well under pressure
- Work well in a close team environment
- Ability to problem-solve
- Drivers license mandatory

If you’re a motivated individual with the right skills and attitude, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to become a part of our growing team at Structability.

TWK Steel is an Australian based steel fabrication business specialising in large scale civil and infrastructure projects. Servicing clients across the country, we offer a range of fabricated steel solutions which are designed to meet the needs of the Australian market. TWK Steel is also a stockist of Nippon Steel sheet pile, manufactured in Japan. Combining innovation with exceptional quality products, TWK Steel has been designing, manufacturing and delivering our clients with bespoke steel solutions for over a decade.

With the capacity to deliver over 10,000 ton of fabricated steel per year, TWK Steel provides you with the peace of mind that quality, safety and cost-efficiency are at the forefront of our business.

We are seeking qualified Welders to join our dedicated team of professionals. We are looking for hardworking individuals who can meet company challenges and surpass client expectations.

As a Welder, your core responsibilities involve reading blueprints, preparing materials, operating cutting tools, and assembling structural components while adhering to strict safety protocols.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Read and interpret project plans, engineering drawings, blueprints and other written instructions and diagrams to perform task at hand
Perform fabrication and repair works on various metal structures and components according to engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Work with variety of materials, including steel, aluminium, and other alloys
Weld small and large components such as copper plumbing, beams, and pipelines

Weld components in flat, vertical, and overhead positions
Ensure fabrication and repairs are carried out using the proper safety guidelines to ensure rework jobs do not occur

Job Title: 		Metal Fabricator
Salary range: 		$79,500 - $86,600 - depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closure date:	30 days

About the Role
On behalf of our client - a leading structural steel fabricator specialising in commercial, industrial, and infrastructure projects - we are seeking an experienced Metal Fabricator. The company operates a state-of-the-art facility with advanced CNC, plasma cutting, and automated welding equipment, delivering precision-engineered steelwork for high-profile builds. This role is critical to maintaining their reputation for quality, safety, and on-time delivery.

Key Duties & Responsibilities
Preparation & Planning
• Interpret complex blueprints, shop drawings, and specifications to determine material requirements, weld symbols, and assembly sequences.
• Conduct material take-offs and plan efficient cutting layouts to minimise waste, liaising with detailers and project managers.

Cutting & Shaping
• Operate CNC plasma cutters, oxy-fuel torches, and band saws to cut structural steel sections (beams, columns, channels) to precise dimensions.
• Shape and bend metal sections and pipes using hydraulic presses, rollers, and manual methods (heating, hammering) to achieve required profiles.

Assembly & Joining
• Align and tack components using clamps, jigs, and measuring instruments (levels, squares, tape measures) to ensure dimensional accuracy.
• Join steel sections via flux-cored arc welding (FCAW), MIG, or stick welding, as well as bolting and riveting for field connections.

Finishing & Quality Control
• Inspect welds for bead width, penetration, and uniformity; perform non-destructive testing (visual, dye penetrant) as required.
• Grind, file, and polish welds and surfaces to specified finish; apply protective coatings or acid washes to prevent corrosion.

Essential Qualifications & Experience
• Certificate III in Engineering - Fabrication Trade or equivalent qualification
• Minimum 2 years' post-apprenticeship experience in metal fabrication and welding within an industrial environment
• Proficiency in reading engineering drawings and using manual/machine tools.
• Strong welding skills (FCAW/MIG) and knowledge of Australian welding standards.
• Commitment to workplace safety and quality assurance.

Essential Skills & Attributes
• Exceptional attention to detail with commitment to producing high-quality craftsmanship
• Strong problem-solving skills with ability to troubleshoot fabrication and welding challenges
• Physical capability to handle heavy materials and work in demanding industrial environments
• Excellent teamwork and communication skills with ability to collaborate effectively with tradespeople and engineers
• Reliability and strong work ethic with commitment to meeting project deadlines and quality standards
• Adaptability to work across diverse projects and willingness to continuously develop technical skills

To Apply
If you are an experienced Metal Fabricator/Welder seeking a permanent role with an industry leader, we encourage you to apply. Please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and qualifications through the application portal.

Please note: We are managing this recruitment process on behalf of our client. All applications will be reviewed by our team before being presented to the client.

We have been making an impression since 1903 — making us Australia's oldest signage company. From our Sunshine West facility we design, fabricate, install and maintain signage for some of the country's best-known brands, covering everything from illuminated pylon signs and shopfronts through to large-format architectural and retail projects.

Our workshop is the heart of the business. We are looking for a skilled Fabricator / Welder to join our production team.

About the role
Reporting to the Production Manager, you will fabricate signage components and structures from mild steel, stainless steel and aluminum — working from shop drawings through to a finished product ready for paint, powder coat and installation.

Day to day you will:
Fabricate sign frames, lightboxes, pylon structures, brackets and mounting hardware
MIG and TIG weld aluminum, mild steel and stainless steel to a high finish standard
Read and interpret engineering drawings, shop drawings, specifications and cut lists
Measure, mark out, cut, fold, drill, grind and lines to tolerance
Assemble and trial-fit structures, including housings for illuminated and LED components
Prepare completed work for surface finishing and dispatch
Carry out quality checks against specification before sign-off
Maintain a clean, safe and organised work area and comply with all WHS requirements

Full working rights in Australia

Highly regarded
Previous experience in signage, sheet metal or architectural metal fabrication

Full-time, ongoing position with a stable, long-established Australian business
